detail: Dataset represents transactional order lines where each row corresponds to an order from January 1, 2026 to September 30, 2026.
Row count is set to 2,000 to match the Orders scorecard showing 2,000 orders.
Units sold per order item range uniformly between 1 and 6 to approximate the total 6,924 units sold.
Product catalog, unit prices, and category assignments are invented approximations to match categories Electronics, Home, Apparel, and Office.
Revenues are computed directly from unit price multiplied by units sold, yielding an aggregate close to the reported $436.6K total revenue.
All sample rows are synthetic and invented for demonstration; they do not represent recovered original underlying records.
Schema edited by user; every row remains invented sample data.
